messages:
sara_pm: Flagging a new ask from Atlas variant: must guarantee EU-only audit storage, BYOK export into customer S3 (no key escrow), and immutable cold-archive that meets >5y retention with legal-hold overrides. They want pricing for long-term storage and an operations playbook for legal discovery. Need a decision this sprint.

michael_eng: Quick notes: EU-only => region tags on write paths + separate storage buckets/tenants. BYOK without escrow means we implement envelope encryption: we encrypt with a per-export DEK encrypted with customer KMS. We never store unwrapped keys. For immutability, object-lock/WORM on archive buckets + signed manifests.

anita_security: Also require signed manifests with detached signatures (RSA/ECDSA), manifest contains sha256 checksums and provenance fields. Define key rotation policy in handshake: if key rotates, customer must provide new KMS ARN and we rewrap DEKs but we cannot re-encrypt historical archives (we must document).

maria_data: From data side: retention tiers plan: hot (90d), warm (1y), cold (1-7y) with lifecycle transitions. For 5+ years we should offer cold+deep-archive lifecycle. We need cost estimate per TB/year and a throttle policy for export jobs to avoid billing spikes.

sara_pm: Can we list concrete launch gates? I propose: 1) Residency + schema spec, 2) BYOK export handshake + CI test to EU S3, 3) Archive immutability POC + verification tool, 4) Pricing doc + finance signoff, 5) Ops playbook + legal-discovery run.

michael_eng: Implementation rough split: storage plumbing + residency tags (1 week), BYOK export flow + CI (2 sprints), archive immutability + verification tooling (2 sprints), export SLA and throttling (0.5 sprint). Integration & security review add 1 sprint.

leo_finance: For pricing: cold/archival assumed at $15/TB/month equivalent market price; deep-archive $2/TB/month. We need to model retention of immutability metadata in hot index (small but persistent). Also propose a monthly quota for automated exports to cap cost exposure.

anita_security: Acceptance criteria suggestions: Gate1: spec doc with sample tenant JSON and residency flags; Gate2: CI job that performs an end-to-end export into a test EU bucket using customer KMS (no key material in logs), with automated integrity check; Gate3: proof-of-immutability via object-lock policy + a verification tool that can show manifest hash existed before deletion window; Gate4: published price sheet and quota default; Gate5: runbook with playbook for legal hold and a tested restore drill.

maria_data: Sample event metadata to include (short): `event_time`, `tenant_id`, `region_tag`, `event_type`, `payload_hash`, `retention_tier`, `evidence_id`, `provenance` (who/what triggered).

sara_pm: Ops ask: please add a rollback plan if export fails mid-stream (partial upload). Also define SLA targets: target export completion SLO 95% within 12h for <1TB.

michael_eng: Agreed on partial upload handling: use transactional manifest + multipart uploads + upload session state. If failure, mark manifest as `partial` and require re-run to produce a `complete` manifest with replaced GUID. We'll also keep tombstone markers for partials.

ops-bot: Spec CI: residency-spec-v1 updated at https://redwood.internal/docs/residency-spec (CI: passed). :white_check_mark:

leo_finance: One more: add billing alert when archival growth >+50% month-over-month for any tenant to avoid surprise bills.

anita_security: Legal/contract note: we must not accept any responsibility to decrypt customer-kept keys. Add clause for customer-provided KMS access controls and rotate/escrow responsibilities.

sara_pm: Actions: michael to PR export prototype to staging (ETA: 2w), anita to publish evidence manifest template (ETA: 4d), maria to finalize retention tiers and cost assumption (ETA: 3d), leo to draft pricing guardrails + quota defaults (ETA: 5d). I'll schedule a gating review on next Tuesday.

michael_eng: I'll post the staging PR link once ready and include a simple test harness script.

anita_security: I'll include example verification commands and a small complaint checklist for SOC2 auditors.

sara_pm: Thanks team 44d Will capture this in the roadmap milestone and ping Atlas on proposed phasing.
